lexSnapshot.wordGrammar: 3rd person feminine singular (form VII) perfect verb
lexSnapshot.derivativeNote: ٱنكَدَرَتْ is in the derivative form: اِنْكَدَرَ
lexSnapshot.rootDefinitionHtml:
ك/د/ر   k–d–r to be muddy, grimy, dreary; to be troubled; cloud of dust; to assail, to scatter. Of this root, اِنْكَدَرَت ʾinkadarat occurs 1 time in the Qur’an
.
lexSnapshot.mainDefinitionHtml:
اِنْكَدَرَ ʾinkadara [v. VII, intrans.] to become murky, to become dim

(81:2) وَإِذَا النُّجُومُ انْكَدَرَتْ when the stars are dimmed.
